# Motif2 deconfounding tests (tests 1 and 3)
```{r test1-motif2-deconfounding-regression, include=TRUE, eval=FALSE, echo=TRUE}
# ---- TEST 1: does Motif2 dosage predict primary Trh/Tgo occupancy, ----
# ---- independent of GC, width, TSS distance, CME? ----
# Outcome: MACS3 fold-enrichment over input (data/chapter3/trh_joint_macs3_fe.csv,
# the value at the summit of the IDR-paired replicate peaks, averaged over the two
# replicates). signalValue is mean pooled-ChIP coverage and is not input-normalised;
# the same model on signalValue is kept as fit_signal for comparison.
# Runs on the LIVE objects produced earlier in this Rmd:
#   joint_peaks_filt (614 peaks, with signalValue/distanceToTSS/CME mcols)
#   fimo_gr          (motif instances; must be subset to Motif2)
EXPORT_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "data/chapter3")

library(GenomicRanges); library(Biostrings)
library(BSgenome.Dmelanogaster.UCSC.dm6)

stopifnot(exists("joint_peaks_filt"), length(joint_peaks_filt) == 614)
stopifnot(exists("fimo_gr"))

# --- isolate Motif2 from CME / Motif_1 contamination --------------
cat("motif_id contents of fimo_gr:\n"); print(table(fimo_gr$motif_id))
motif2_gr <- fimo_gr[fimo_gr$motif_id == "STRCACTGARARAAA"]
stopifnot(length(motif2_gr) > 0)   # 0 means the FIMO motif labels differ
cat("Motif2 instances used for dosage:", length(motif2_gr), "\n")

genome <- BSgenome.Dmelanogaster.UCSC.dm6
seqs   <- getSeq(genome, joint_peaks_filt)

fe_tab <- read.csv(file.path(EXPORT_DIR, "trh_joint_macs3_fe.csv"))
stopifnot(nrow(fe_tab) == length(joint_peaks_filt),
          all(fe_tab$seqnames == as.character(seqnames(joint_peaks_filt))),
          all(fe_tab$start == start(joint_peaks_filt)), all(fe_tab$end == end(joint_peaks_filt)),
          !anyNA(fe_tab$macs3_fold_enrichment))

df <- data.frame(
  peak_score   = fe_tab$macs3_fold_enrichment,
  signal_value = joint_peaks_filt$signalValue,
  width        = width(joint_peaks_filt),
  dist_tss     = joint_peaks_filt$distanceToTSS,
  has_cme      = as.integer(joint_peaks_filt$CME),
  n_motif2     = countOverlaps(joint_peaks_filt, motif2_gr, ignore.strand = TRUE),
  gc_content   = as.numeric(letterFrequency(seqs, "GC", as.prob = TRUE))
)
df$has_motif2    <- as.integer(df$n_motif2 > 0)
df$log_dist_tss  <- log10(df$dist_tss + 1)

# --- full model + collinearity ----------------------------------------------
fit_full <- lm(peak_score ~ gc_content + width + log_dist_tss + has_cme + n_motif2,
               data = df)
fit_signal <- lm(signal_value ~ gc_content + width + log_dist_tss + has_cme + n_motif2,
                 data = df)   # raw coverage as outcome, for comparison
if (!requireNamespace("car", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("car")
cat("\n--- VIF (flag > 5) ---\n");   print(car::vif(fit_full))
cat("\n--- full model ---\n");       print(summary(fit_full))

# --- nested F-test: does Motif2 add over confounders? -----------------------
fit_reduced <- lm(peak_score ~ gc_content + width + log_dist_tss + has_cme, data = df)
cat("\n--- nested F-test ---\n");     print(anova(fit_reduced, fit_full))
cat("adj R^2 without Motif2:", summary(fit_reduced)$adj.r.squared, "\n")
cat("adj R^2 with    Motif2:", summary(fit_full)$adj.r.squared,    "\n")

# --- binary robustness ------------------------------------------------------
fit_bin <- lm(peak_score ~ gc_content + width + log_dist_tss + has_cme + has_motif2,
              data = df)
cat("\n--- binary Motif2 ---\n")
print(summary(fit_bin)$coefficients["has_motif2", , drop = FALSE])

# === REFEREE PRE-EMPTS (added after TEST1 review) ===========================
# (a) log-outcome: fold-enrichment is right-skewed; does the sign/significance hold?
fit_log <- lm(log1p(peak_score) ~ gc_content + width + log_dist_tss + has_cme + n_motif2,
              data = df)
cat("\n--- (a) log-outcome ---\n")
print(summary(fit_log)$coefficients["n_motif2", , drop = FALSE])

# (b) GC-only adjustment: strips possible mediator conditioning (TSS dist/width)
fit_gc <- lm(peak_score ~ gc_content + n_motif2, data = df)
cat("\n--- (b) GC-only adjustment ---\n")
print(summary(fit_gc)$coefficients["n_motif2", , drop = FALSE])

# (c) heteroscedasticity-robust SEs (HC3) on the full model
if (!requireNamespace("sandwich", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("sandwich")
if (!requireNamespace("lmtest",   quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("lmtest")
cat("\n--- (c) HC3-robust SEs, full model ---\n")
print(lmtest::coeftest(fit_full, vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(fit_full, type = "HC3")))

saveRDS(list(full = fit_full, reduced = fit_reduced, binary = fit_bin,
             log = fit_log, gc_only = fit_gc, signal = fit_signal,
             vif = car::vif(fit_full), df = df,
             outcome = "MACS3 fold-enrichment over input; element signal holds the same model on raw coverage"),
        file.path(EXPORT_DIR, "test1_regression_binding.rds"))
```

```{r test3-motif2-phylop-conservation, include=TRUE, eval=FALSE, echo=TRUE}
# ---- TEST 3: is Motif2 under purifying selection relative to its OWN ----
# ---- immediate flanking sequence? (within-locus paired design) ----
# PREREQUISITE: download the dm6 phyloP27way conservation track from UCSC:
#   cd $PROJECT_DIR/data/chapter3
#   curl -O https://hgdownload.soe.ucsc.edu/goldenPath/dm6/phyloP27way/dm6.phyloP27way.bw
EXPORT_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "data/chapter3")

library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)

BW_PATH <- file.path(EXPORT_DIR, "dm6.phyloP27way.bw")
FLANK_W <- 50L
stopifnot(file.exists(BW_PATH))
stopifnot(exists("joint_peaks_filt"), exists("fimo_gr"))

# --- isolate Motif2 instances; this is the MASTER object & ordering ----------
cat("motif_id contents of fimo_gr:\n"); print(table(fimo_gr$motif_id))
motif2_gr <- fimo_gr[fimo_gr$motif_id == "STRCACTGARARAAA"]
motif2_gr <- sort(unique(motif2_gr))           # keep strand (needed for core)
stopifnot(length(motif2_gr) > 0, all(width(motif2_gr) == 15L))
cat("Motif2 instances entering phyloP test:", length(motif2_gr), "\n")

# unstranded copy for scoring (phyloP is strand-agnostic); same order/coords
motif2_us <- motif2_gr; strand(motif2_us) <- "*"

# --- chromosome-naming compatibility check -----------------------------------
bwf    <- BigWigFile(BW_PATH)
bw_chr <- seqnames(seqinfo(bwf))
if (!all(as.character(seqnames(motif2_us)) %in% bw_chr)) {
  warning("seqlevel mismatch between motif2_gr and bigWig; check chr naming")
  print(setdiff(unique(as.character(seqnames(motif2_us))), bw_chr))
}
sl <- seqlengths(seqinfo(bwf))

# --- matched flanks: same-locus, immediately adjacent, clamped to chr ---------
left_fl  <- GRanges(seqnames(motif2_us),
                    IRanges(start(motif2_us) - FLANK_W, start(motif2_us) - 1L))
right_fl <- GRanges(seqnames(motif2_us),
                    IRanges(end(motif2_us) + 1L, end(motif2_us) + FLANK_W))
clamp <- function(g) {
  L <- sl[as.character(seqnames(g))]
  start(g) <- pmax(start(g), 1L); end(g) <- pmin(end(g), L); g
}
left_fl <- clamp(left_fl); right_fl <- clamp(right_fl)

# drop any instance whose flank abuts a NEIGHBOURING motif (contamination check)
fl_touch_motif <- countOverlaps(left_fl,  motif2_us, ignore.strand = TRUE) +
  countOverlaps(right_fl, motif2_us, ignore.strand = TRUE)

# --- per-region mean phyloP (version-robust extractor) ------------------------
region_mean <- function(bwf, gr) {
  s <- summary(bwf, gr, size = 1L, type = "mean")
  if (methods::is(s, "RleList")) {
    v <- vapply(s, function(r){x <- as.numeric(r); if(length(x)) x[1] else NA_real_}, numeric(1))
  } else {
    v <- vapply(s, function(g){if(length(g)) as.numeric(score(g))[1] else NA_real_}, numeric(1))
  }
  v[is.nan(v)] <- NA_real_; as.numeric(v)
}

motif_pp <- region_mean(bwf, motif2_us)
left_pp  <- region_mean(bwf, left_fl)
right_pp <- region_mean(bwf, right_fl)
flank_pp <- rowMeans(cbind(left_pp, right_pp), na.rm = TRUE)
flank_pp[is.nan(flank_pp)] <- NA_real_

# --- CACTG core (positions 4-8 of the 15-mer, strand-aware) -------------------
# Derived from motif2_gr -> identical ordering to flank_pp / fl_touch_motif.
core <- motif2_gr
plus <- as.logical(strand(motif2_gr) == "+")
start(core)[plus]  <- start(motif2_gr)[plus] + 3L
end(core)[plus]    <- start(motif2_gr)[plus] + 7L
start(core)[!plus] <- end(motif2_gr)[!plus]  - 7L
end(core)[!plus]   <- end(motif2_gr)[!plus]  - 3L
strand(core) <- "*"
core_pp <- region_mean(bwf, core)

# --- assemble paired tables, drop NA pairs and motif-adjacent flanks ----------
ok       <- is.finite(flank_pp) & fl_touch_motif == 0
pp_k     <- data.frame(motif = motif_pp, flank = flank_pp)[ok & is.finite(motif_pp), ]
pp_core  <- data.frame(core  = core_pp,  flank = flank_pp)[ok & is.finite(core_pp),  ]
cat("Full-motif pairs retained:", nrow(pp_k),
    "| CACTG-core pairs retained:", nrow(pp_core),
    "of", length(motif2_gr), "\n")
stopifnot(nrow(pp_k) >= 10)

# --- paired tests -------------------------------------------------------------
wt      <- wilcox.test(pp_k$motif,   pp_k$flank,   paired = TRUE)
wt_core <- wilcox.test(pp_core$core, pp_core$flank, paired = TRUE)
prop_up <- mean(pp_k$motif > pp_k$flank)

cat("\n=== TEST 3: Motif2 phyloP vs own ±", FLANK_W, "bp flank ===\n", sep = "")
cat("full motif : median", round(median(pp_k$motif), 4),
    "vs flank", round(median(pp_k$flank), 4),
    "| diff", round(median(pp_k$motif - pp_k$flank), 4),
    "| prop>flank", round(prop_up, 3),
    "| p", formatC(wt$p.value, format = "e", digits = 2), "\n")
cat("CACTG core : median", round(median(pp_core$core), 4),
    "vs flank", round(median(pp_core$flank), 4),
    "| diff", round(median(pp_core$core - pp_core$flank), 4),
    "| p", formatC(wt_core$p.value, format = "e", digits = 2), "\n")

saveRDS(list(full = list(table = pp_k,    wilcox = wt,      prop_up = prop_up),
             core = list(table = pp_core, wilcox = wt_core),
             flank_w = FLANK_W, n_instances = length(motif2_gr)),
        file.path(EXPORT_DIR, "test3_phylop_conservation.rds"))
```

```{r cme-motif2-spacing,include=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
# Get spacing between CME and Motif2 centres within co-occurring peaks
cme_in_both    <- subsetByOverlaps(cme_genomic, peaks_both, ignore.strand = TRUE)
motif2_in_both <- subsetByOverlaps(fimo_gr, peaks_both, ignore.strand = TRUE)

# For each peak, find minimum CME-to-motif2 centre distance
spacings <- sapply(seq_along(peaks_both), function(i) {
  cme_i <- subsetByOverlaps(
    cme_in_both, peaks_both[i], ignore.strand = TRUE)
  m3_i  <- subsetByOverlaps(
    motif2_in_both, peaks_both[i], ignore.strand = TRUE)
  if (length(cme_i) == 0 || length(m3_i) == 0) return(NA)
  min(abs(outer(mid(ranges(cme_i)), mid(ranges(m3_i)), "-")))
})

spacings <- spacings[!is.na(spacings)]
cat("Median CME-Motif2 spacing:", median(spacings), "bp\n")
cat("Range:", min(spacings), "to", max(spacings), "bp\n")

png(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "fig3_17_cme_motif2_spacing.png"),
    width = 2400, height = 1200, res = 300)
hist(spacings,
     breaks = 21,
     main = "",  # <- removes title
     xlab = "Minimum centre-to-centre distance (bp)",
     xlim = c(0, 300),
     col  = PAL_HETERO[["Trh/Tgo"]],
     border = PAL_INK[["on_mark"]])
while(!is.null(dev.list()))
dev.off()
```

## Motif2 in CME-positive vs CME-negative peaks

```{r cme-stratified-motif2, include=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
# ============================================================
# FIGURE 3.16, Motif2 frequency in CME-positive vs CME-negative peaks
# Tests whether CACTGA (Motif2) substitutes for ACGTG (CME) in CME-negative
# peaks, or whether the two motifs are independent of each other.
# Requires: joint_peaks_filt$CME and joint_peaks_filt$Motif2 both TRUE/FALSE
# ============================================================
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

stopifnot("CME"    %in% names(mcols(joint_peaks_filt)))
stopifnot("Motif2" %in% names(mcols(joint_peaks_filt)))

df_cme_m2 <- as.data.frame(mcols(joint_peaks_filt)) %>%
  dplyr::select(CME, Motif2, Regulatory_Class) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    CME_status = ifelse(CME,     "CME-positive", "CME-negative"),
    M2_status  = ifelse(Motif2, "Motif2 present", "Motif2 absent")
  )

# ---- 1. Primary contingency table: CME status x Motif2 ----
tab_cme_m2 <- table(CME_status = df_cme_m2$CME_status,
                    Motif2    = df_cme_m2$Motif2)
cat("=== CME status x Motif2 contingency table ===\n")
print(tab_cme_m2)

freq_cme_m2 <- prop.table(tab_cme_m2, margin = 1) * 100
cat("\nMotif2 prevalence (%) within each CME class:\n")
print(round(freq_cme_m2, 1))

# Fisher exact test
ft_cme_m2 <- fisher.test(tab_cme_m2)
cat("\nFisher exact test (CME status x Motif2):\n")
cat("  OR =", round(ft_cme_m2$estimate, 3), "\n")
cat("  p  =", formatC(ft_cme_m2$p.value, format = "e", digits = 2), "\n")
cat("\nInterpretation:\n")
cat("  OR > 1 -> Motif2 enriched in CME-positive (co-occurrence)\n")
cat("  OR < 1 -> Motif2 enriched in CME-negative (substitution)\n")
cat("  OR ~ 1 -> Motif2 independent of CME status\n")

# ---- 2. Store key values for export ----
cme_pos_m2_n   <- as.integer(tab_cme_m2["CME-positive", "TRUE"])
cme_neg_m2_n   <- as.integer(tab_cme_m2["CME-negative", "TRUE"])
cme_pos_total  <- sum(tab_cme_m2["CME-positive", ])
cme_neg_total  <- sum(tab_cme_m2["CME-negative", ])
cme_pos_m2_pct <- round(100 * cme_pos_m2_n / cme_pos_total, 1)
cme_neg_m2_pct <- round(100 * cme_neg_m2_n / cme_neg_total, 1)
cme_m2_OR      <- round(ft_cme_m2$estimate, 2)
cme_m2_pval    <- ft_cme_m2$p.value

# ---- 3. Figure 3.17 ----
plot_df_cme <- data.frame(
  CME_status = c("CME-positive", "CME-negative"),
  n_total    = c(cme_pos_total,  cme_neg_total),
  n_motif2   = c(cme_pos_m2_n,  cme_neg_m2_n),
  pct_motif2 = c(cme_pos_m2_pct, cme_neg_m2_pct),
  col        = unname(pal_binary("CME-positive", "CME-negative"))
)
plot_df_cme$label <- paste0(plot_df_cme$pct_motif2, "%\n(",
                             plot_df_cme$n_motif2, "/",
                             plot_df_cme$n_total, ")")

pval_fmt_cme <- if (cme_m2_pval < 0.001) {
  parts <- strsplit(formatC(cme_m2_pval, format = "e", digits = 2), "e")[[1]]
  paste0("italic(p)==", parts[1], " %*% 10^{", as.integer(parts[2]), "}")
} else {
  paste0("italic(p)==", round(cme_m2_pval, 3))
}

p316 <- (function() {
  plot_df_cme$Count <- sprintf("(%d/%d)", plot_df_cme$n_motif2, plot_df_cme$n_total)
  fills316 <- pal_binary("CME-positive", "CME-negative")
  thesis_bar(plot_df_cme, x = "CME_status", y = "pct_motif2", fill = "CME_status",
             value_fmt = "%.1f%%", count = "Count", fills = fills316,
             y_lab = "Peaks containing Motif2 (%)", global_p = cme_m2_pval)
})()
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "fig3_17_cme_motif2_enrichment.png"), p316,
       width = 5, height = 4.3, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
cat("Saved: fig3_17_cme_motif2_enrichment.png\n")
```

```{bash fimo-four-way-scan, include=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
# ============================================================
# FIMO scan of four sets with PWM STRCACTGARARAAA.meme, --thresh 1.0E-4, --bgfile --nrdb--, run on the HPC.

# Requires in EXPORT_DIR (data/chapter3): STRCACTGARARAAA.meme, joint.fa, trh_unique.fa, tgo_unique.fa, enhancers_genomewide.fa
# ============================================================
cd $PROJECT_DIR/data/chapter3

for SET in joint trh_unique tgo_unique enhancers_genomewide; do
  conda run -n phd fimo \
    --oc fimo_${SET} \

    --bgfile --nrdb-- \
    --thresh 1.0E-4 \
    STRCACTGARARAAA.meme \
    ${SET}.fa
  echo "Done: fimo_${SET}/fimo.tsv"
done
```

```{r motif2-fimo-prevalence}
# ============================================================
# Motif2 prevalence loader.
# FIMO collapses headers to chromosome names in sequence_name and reports hits in absolute genome coordinates, so unique(sequence_name) counts chromosomes; enhancer set is counted by genomic overlap instead.
# q-value is corrected per scan, not comparable between the 614-peak scan and the 35798-enhancer scan; cross-set comparison uses p-value < 1e-4.
# ============================================================
library(GenomicRanges)

PVAL_THRESH <- 1e-4   # matches the FIMO --thresh used for all four scans

# --- Loader A: peak sets scanned with peak_N FASTA headers -------------------
# sequence_name == "peak_<i>"; one row per hit; count distinct peaks hit.
motif2_prev_peakindexed <- function(fimo_tsv, n_total, label) {
  stopifnot(file.exists(fimo_tsv))
  f <- read.table(fimo_tsv, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", comment.char = "#")
  # FIMO writes the p-value column as "p.value" after read.table name-munging
  f <- f[f$p.value < PVAL_THRESH, ]
  n_pos <- length(unique(f$sequence_name))
  pct   <- round(100 * n_pos / n_total, 1)
  cat(label, ": Motif2 in", n_pos, "/", n_total,
      paste0("(", pct, "%)\n"))
  list(n_pos = n_pos, n_total = n_total, pct = pct)
}

# --- Loader B: enhancer set scanned with genomic FASTA headers ---------------
# sequence_name == chromosome; start/stop are ABSOLUTE genome coordinates.
# Build a GRanges of hits and count target intervals with >=1 overlap.
motif2_prev_genomic <- function(fimo_tsv, target_gr, label) {
  stopifnot(file.exists(fimo_tsv))
  f <- read.table(fimo_tsv, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", comment.char = "#")
  f <- f[f$p.value < PVAL_THRESH, ]
  hits_gr <- GRanges(
    seqnames = f$sequence_name,
    ranges   = IRanges(start = f$start, end = f$stop),
    strand   = f$strand
  )
  hit_target <- countOverlaps(target_gr, hits_gr, ignore.strand = TRUE) > 0
  n_pos <- sum(hit_target)
  n_tot <- length(target_gr)
  pct   <- round(100 * n_pos / n_tot, 1)
  cat(label, ": Motif2 in", n_pos, "/", n_tot,
      paste0("(", pct, "%)\n"))
  list(n_pos = n_pos, n_total = n_tot, pct = pct)
}

# --- Four scans --------------------------------------------------------------
# confirm the joint / unique fimo.tsv files use peak_N naming.
# tail their footers; if any used genomic headers, switch it to loader B.
joint_m2 <- motif2_prev_peakindexed(
  file.path(EXPORT_DIR, "fimo_joint", "fimo.tsv"),
  length(joint_peaks_filt), "Trh/Tgo joint")

trh_u_m2 <- motif2_prev_peakindexed(
  file.path(EXPORT_DIR, "fimo_trh_unique", "fimo.tsv"),
  length(trh_unique_peaks), "Trh-unique")

tgo_u_m2 <- motif2_prev_peakindexed(
  file.path(EXPORT_DIR, "fimo_tgo_unique", "fimo.tsv"),
  length(tgo_unique_peaks), "Tgo-unique")

enh_m2 <- motif2_prev_genomic(
  file.path(EXPORT_DIR, "fimo_enhancers_genomewide", "fimo.tsv"),
  enhancers_filt_pwm, "Genome-wide enhancers")

# --- Variables consumed by Figure 3.17 and the computed-values export --------
joint_m2_n         <- joint_m2$n_pos
joint_m2_total     <- joint_m2$n_total
joint_m2_pct       <- joint_m2$pct

trh_unique_m2_n    <- trh_u_m2$n_pos
trh_unique_n_total <- trh_u_m2$n_total
trh_unique_m2_pct  <- trh_u_m2$pct

tgo_unique_m2_n    <- tgo_u_m2$n_pos
tgo_unique_n_total <- tgo_u_m2$n_total
tgo_unique_m2_pct  <- tgo_u_m2$pct

mspec_n_enh_m2_pos <- enh_m2$n_pos
mspec_n_enh_total  <- enh_m2$n_total
mspec_enh_pct      <- enh_m2$pct

# --- Fisher tests: each unique set vs joint reference ------------------------
ft_trh_unique <- fisher.test(matrix(
  c(joint_m2_n,      joint_m2_total - joint_m2_n,
    trh_unique_m2_n, trh_unique_n_total - trh_unique_m2_n), nrow = 2))
ft_tgo_unique <- fisher.test(matrix(
  c(joint_m2_n,      joint_m2_total - joint_m2_n,
    tgo_unique_m2_n, tgo_unique_n_total - tgo_unique_m2_n), nrow = 2))

cat("\nFisher (joint vs Trh-unique):  OR =", round(ft_trh_unique$estimate, 2),
    " p =", formatC(ft_trh_unique$p.value, format = "e", digits = 2), "\n")
cat("Fisher (joint vs Tgo-unique):  OR =", round(ft_tgo_unique$estimate, 2),
    " p =", formatC(ft_tgo_unique$p.value, format = "e", digits = 2), "\n")

ft_trh_OR <- round(ft_trh_unique$estimate, 2); ft_trh_p <- ft_trh_unique$p.value
ft_tgo_OR <- round(ft_tgo_unique$estimate, 2); ft_tgo_p <- ft_tgo_unique$p.value

motif2_summary <- data.frame(
  Peak_set   = c("Trh/Tgo joint (reference)", "Trh-unique (no Tgo)",
                 "Tgo-unique (no Trh)", "Genome-wide enhancers"),
  N_total    = c(joint_m2_total, trh_unique_n_total,
                 tgo_unique_n_total, mspec_n_enh_total),
  N_motif2   = c(joint_m2_n, trh_unique_m2_n,
                 tgo_unique_m2_n, mspec_n_enh_m2_pos),
  Pct_motif2 = c(joint_m2_pct, trh_unique_m2_pct,
                 tgo_unique_m2_pct, mspec_enh_pct),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat("\n=== Motif2 prevalence (full-PWM FIMO, p < 1e-4) ===\n")
print(motif2_summary)

# --- Fisher test: joint peaks vs genome-wide enhancer baseline ---------------
# This is the tier-1 test: is Motif2 enriched at bHLH-PAS binding sites
# relative to the genome-wide annotated-enhancer average?
ft_joint_vs_enh <- fisher.test(matrix(
  c(joint_m2_n,                  joint_m2_total - joint_m2_n,
    mspec_n_enh_m2_pos,          mspec_n_enh_total - mspec_n_enh_m2_pos),
  nrow = 2))

cat("\nFisher (joint vs genome-wide enhancers):  OR =",
    round(ft_joint_vs_enh$estimate, 2),
    " p =", formatC(ft_joint_vs_enh$p.value, format = "e", digits = 2), "\n")

mspec_peaks_vs_enh_or <- round(ft_joint_vs_enh$estimate, 2)
mspec_peaks_vs_enh_p  <- ft_joint_vs_enh$p.value
```

```{r length-check}
# --- Width sanity check: PWM is 15 bp; any interval < 15 bp cannot hit -------
check_widths <- function(gr, label) {
  w <- width(gr)
  n_short <- sum(w < 15)
  cat(sprintf("%-22s n=%6d  min=%5d  median=%6.0f  <15bp: %d\n",
              label, length(gr), min(w), median(w), n_short))
  if (n_short > 0) {
    cat("  WARNING:", n_short, "intervals <15bp in", label,
        "-- these are forced negatives; consider a width>=15 filter.\n")
  }
  invisible(n_short)
}
check_widths(joint_peaks_filt,   "Trh/Tgo joint")
check_widths(trh_unique_peaks,   "Trh-unique")
check_widths(tgo_unique_peaks,   "Tgo-unique")
check_widths(enhancers_filt_pwm, "Enhancers (PWM set)")
```

```{r, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# ====
# Exports Chapter 3 reported values to results/reported_values.tsv; run last, after analyses.
# ====

# ---- Helper: format p-values for scientific notation ----
fmt_p <- function(p, digits = 2) {
  formatted <- formatC(p, format = "e", digits = digits)
  parts <- strsplit(formatted, "e")[[1]]
  mantissa <- parts[1]
  exponent <- as.integer(parts[2])
  paste0(mantissa, "e", exponent)
}

fmt_sci <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  # Wrapper for already-known values passed as strings (no recomputation needed)
  x
}

# ============================================================
# SECTION 1, Peak counts (from IDR-filtered narrowPeak files)
# Objects: Trh_clean, Tgo_clean, joint_peaks_filt
# ============================================================
trh_peaks_n  <- length(Trh_clean)           # 1033
tgo_peaks_n  <- length(Tgo_clean)           # 1403
joint_n      <- length(joint_peaks_filt)    # 614

# Percentages for Trh and Tgo participating in joint set.
# joint_n counts pintersect intervals, not peaks; dividing by tgo_peaks_n overstates Tgo share (tgo_unique.fa: 1403 - 609 = 794).
# Count distinct peaks per side.
hits_tt        <- findOverlaps(Trh_clean, Tgo_clean, minoverlap = 1L)
trh_joint_n    <- length(unique(queryHits(hits_tt)))     # 614
tgo_joint_n    <- length(unique(subjectHits(hits_tt)))   # 609
tgo_spanning_n <- sum(table(subjectHits(hits_tt)) > 1L)  # 5

stopifnot(length(hits_tt) == joint_n,          # pairs == intersection intervals
          all(table(queryHits(hits_tt)) == 1L),# every Trh peak has one partner
          joint_n - tgo_joint_n == tgo_spanning_n)

trh_pct_joint <- round(100 * trh_joint_n / trh_peaks_n, 1)   # 59.4
tgo_pct_joint <- round(100 * tgo_joint_n / tgo_peaks_n, 1)   # 43.4

# Trh-unique peaks (Trh peaks not in joint set)
trh_unique_n  <- trh_peaks_n - joint_n                    # 419

# ============================================================
# SECTION 2, Permutation test: Trh vs Tgo overlap (peakPermTest)
# Object: pt2_ (from Figure 3.6B chunk)
# ============================================================
perm_obs_overlap  <- pt2_$cntOverlaps$observed            # 614
perm_zscore       <- round(pt2_$cntOverlaps$zscore, 2)    # 114.58
perm_pval_raw     <- pt2_$cntOverlaps$pval                # 2.00e-4 (= floor 1/5001)
perm_n            <- length(pt2_$cntOverlaps$permuted)    # 5000
perm_ev95         <- round(quantile(pt2_$cntOverlaps$permuted, 0.95))  # 35
perm_fold         <- round(perm_obs_overlap / mean(pt2_$cntOverlaps$permuted), 0)  # ~23

# ============================================================
# SECTION 3, Enhancer overlap counts (from Figure 3.7B chunk)
# Objects: pt_all, pt_promoter, pt_distal
# ============================================================
enh_obs_all       <- pt_all$numOverlaps$observed           # 169
enh_obs_promoter  <- pt_promoter$numOverlaps$observed      # 55
enh_obs_distal    <- pt_distal$numOverlaps$observed        # 114

enh_null_mean_all <- round(mean(pt_all$numOverlaps$permuted),      2)  # 202.13
enh_null_sd_all   <- round(sd(pt_all$numOverlaps$permuted),        2)  # 11.19
enh_z_all         <- round(pt_all$numOverlaps$zscore,              2)  # -2.96
enh_p_all         <- round(pt_all$numOverlaps$pval, 5)             # 0.0026

enh_null_mean_prom <- round(mean(pt_promoter$numOverlaps$permuted), 2) # 154.46
enh_null_sd_prom   <- round(sd(pt_promoter$numOverlaps$permuted),   2) # 9.99
enh_z_prom         <- round(pt_promoter$numOverlaps$zscore,         2) # -9.95
enh_p_prom         <- round(pt_promoter$numOverlaps$pval,5)                     # 2e-04

enh_null_mean_dist <- round(mean(pt_distal$numOverlaps$permuted),   2) # 46.79
enh_null_sd_dist   <- round(sd(pt_distal$numOverlaps$permuted),     2) # 5.77
enh_z_dist         <- round(pt_distal$numOverlaps$zscore,           2) # 11.64
enh_p_dist         <- round(pt_distal$numOverlaps$pval,5)                       # 2e-04

# ============================================================
# SECTION 4, Reference gene set
# Object: ts_sg_genes, trach_entrez, comp_entrez
# ============================================================
ts_sg_total      <- length(ts_sg_genes)                   # 2053
ts_sg_entrez_n   <- length(trach_entrez)                  # 2049
ts_sg_unmapped_n <- ts_sg_total - ts_sg_entrez_n          # 4

# comp_entrez is a live setdiff() against whatever org.Dm.eg.db is installed
# in the session, so length(comp_entrez) drifts with the annotation package
# and need not match the geneset file that ChIP-Enrich actually read. The
# size is therefore read off the file that was passed to chipenrich(), which
# is the only number the reported ORs correspond to.
.gs_written   <- read.delim(file.path(EXPORT_DIR, "geneset_tracheal_vs_complement.tsv"),
                            header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
.gs_tab       <- table(.gs_written$V1)
comp_entrez_n <- unname(.gs_tab[["All_dm6_minus_tracheal"]])   # 23030
stopifnot(unname(.gs_tab[["tracheal_custom"]]) == ts_sg_entrez_n)

# ChIP-Enrich further restricts each geneset to genes it can place under
# its own locus definition. Those are the denominators the reported
# peak-gene counts (peak genes, tracheal and comparison) belong to.
.ce_custom <- read.csv(file.path(EXPORT_DIR, "chipenrich_ch3_custom.csv"),
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(.ce_custom)  <- .ce_custom$Geneset.ID
ce_trach_modelled_n   <- .ce_custom["tracheal_custom",        "N.Geneset.Genes"]  # 1986
ce_comp_modelled_n    <- .ce_custom["All_dm6_minus_tracheal", "N.Geneset.Genes"]  # 11495

# ============================================================
# SECTION 5, Hypergeometric & permutation: peak-proximal TS/SG genes
# Requires: N, A, B, k, p_hyper, fold_enr from Fig 3.9 chunk
#           pt from permutation chunk
# ============================================================

nearby_genes_n     <- A
overlap_n          <- k                          # 114
hyper_fold         <- round(fold_enr, 2)         # 2.01
hyper_p_val        <- p_hyper                    # 4.39e-13

# Permutation test
perm_obs_tsg       <- pt$perm_eval$observed      # 114
perm_null_mean_tsg <- round(mean(pt$perm_eval$permuted), 2)
perm_null_sd_tsg   <- round(sd(pt$perm_eval$permuted),   2)
perm_z_tsg         <- round(
  (pt$perm_eval$observed - mean(pt$perm_eval$permuted)) /
    sd(pt$perm_eval$permuted), 2)
perm_n_tsg         <- length(pt$perm_eval$permuted)

# Empirical p-value, +1 continuity correction prevents exact zero
perm_p_tsg_raw <- (sum(pt$perm_eval$permuted >= pt$perm_eval$observed) + 1) /
                  (perm_n_tsg + 1)

# Format both p-values identically in scientific notation
fmt_p_sci <- function(p) {
  s        <- formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2)
  parts    <- strsplit(s, "e")[[1]]
  mantissa <- parts[1]
  exponent <- as.integer(parts[2])
  paste0(mantissa, "e", exponent)
}

hyper_p_fmt    <- fmt_p_sci(hyper_p_val)     # 4.39e-13

perm_p_tsg_fmt <- if (perm_p_tsg_raw <= (1 / perm_n_tsg + 1e-10)) {
  # Floor hit, no permuted value reached observed; report as bound
  bound <- formatC(1 / perm_n_tsg, format = "e", digits = 2)
  parts    <- strsplit(bound, "e")[[1]]
  mantissa <- parts[1]
  exponent <- as.integer(parts[2])
  paste0("< ", mantissa, "e", exponent)
  # e.g. "< 2.00e-4"
} else {
  fmt_p_sci(perm_p_tsg_raw)
}
# ============================================================
# SECTION 6, Gene length bias test
# Objects: ts_sg_lengths, other_lengths, wilcox test
# ============================================================
median_tsg_length   <- median(ts_sg_lengths)               # 4685
median_other_length <- median(other_lengths)               # 1512
length_fold         <- round(median_tsg_length / median_other_length, 1)  # 3.1
wtest               <- wilcox.test(ts_sg_lengths, other_lengths)
wilcox_W            <- wtest$statistic                     # 24279486
# p < 2.2e-16, reported as-is

# ============================================================
# SECTION 7, ChIP-Enrich (Table 3.2)
# Object: res_custom (from chipenrich chunk)
# ============================================================
trach_row   <- res_custom[res_custom$Description == "tracheal_custom", ]
comp_row    <- res_custom[res_custom$Description == "All_dm6_minus_tracheal", ]

ce_OR_trach   <- round(trach_row$Odds.Ratio, 2)            # 1.56
ce_p_trach    <- trach_row$P.value                         # 1.82e-4
ce_OR_comp    <- round(comp_row$Odds.Ratio, 2)             # 0.64
ce_peakgenes_trach <- trach_row$N.Geneset.Peak.Genes       # 107
ce_peakgenes_comp  <- comp_row$N.Geneset.Peak.Genes        # 319

trach_row_fet <- res_custom_fet[res_custom_fet$Description == "tracheal_custom", ]
ce_OR_fisher <- round(trach_row_fet$Odds.Ratio, 2)    # 1.99
ce_p_fisher  <- trach_row_fet$P.value                  # 1.26e-8
# ============================================================
# SECTION 8, Regulatory context classification (Figure 3.11)
# Object: summary_df (from fig3_12 chunk)
# ============================================================
# These are computed inside bar_df_35 / df_plot in the fig3_12 chunk
# Recompute from joint_peaks_filt$Regulatory_Class for safety
rc_counts <- table(joint_peaks_filt$Regulatory_Class)

n_prom_nonanno   <- as.integer(rc_counts["Promoter-proximal peak (non-annotated)"])   # 413
n_prom_enh       <- as.integer(rc_counts["Promoter-proximal enhancer (annotated)"])   # 55
n_dist_enh       <- as.integer(rc_counts["Distal enhancer (annotated)"])              # 114
n_dist_nonanno   <- as.integer(rc_counts["Distal peak (non-annotated)"])              # 32

pct_prom_nonanno <- round(100 * n_prom_nonanno / joint_n, 1)  # 67.3
pct_prom_enh     <- round(100 * n_prom_enh / joint_n, 1)      # 9
pct_dist_enh     <- round(100 * n_dist_enh / joint_n, 1)      # 18.6
pct_dist_nonanno <- round(100 * n_dist_nonanno / joint_n, 1)  # 5.2
pct_promoter_total <- round(pct_prom_nonanno + pct_prom_enh, 1) # 76.3

# ============================================================
# SECTION 9, CME analysis (Figure 3.12)
# Object: joint_peaks_filt$CME
# ============================================================
n_cme_pos  <- sum(joint_peaks_filt$CME)           # 186 (both-strand ACGTG)
n_cme_neg  <- sum(!joint_peaks_filt$CME)           # 428
pct_cme_pos <- round(100 * n_cme_pos / joint_n, 1) # 30.3
pct_cme_neg <- round(100 * n_cme_neg / joint_n, 1) # 69.7

cme_wilcox_p <- wilcox.test(signalValue ~ CME,
                             data = as.data.frame(joint_peaks_filt))$p.value  # 0.328

# ============================================================
# SECTION 10, Distal vs promoter ChIP signal (Figure 3.13)
# Object: df_signal
# ============================================================
n_promoter_signal  <- sum(df_signal$Context == "Promoter")                     # 468
n_distal_enh_signal <- sum(df_signal$Context == "Distal enhancer (annotated)") # 114
signal_wilcox_p    <- wilcox.test(signalValue ~ Context, data = df_signal)$p.value  # 7.40e-6

# ============================================================
# SECTION 11, Motif2 contextual enrichment (Figure 3.14)
# Object: tab_refined, joint_peaks_filt$Motif2, Regulatory_Class
# ============================================================
n_motif2_total        <- sum(joint_peaks_filt$Motif2)             # 178
pct_motif2_total      <- round(100 * n_motif2_total / joint_n, 1)  # 29

n_motif2_dist_enh     <- tab_refined["Distal enhancer (annotated)", "TRUE"]          # 60
n_motif2_prom_enh     <- tab_refined["Promoter-proximal enhancer (annotated)", "TRUE"] # 20
n_motif2_prom_nonanno <- tab_refined["Promoter-proximal peak (non-annotated)", "TRUE"] # 86
n_motif2_dist_nonanno <- tab_refined["Distal peak (non-annotated)", "TRUE"]            # 12

pct_motif2_dist_enh     <- round(100 * n_motif2_dist_enh / n_dist_enh, 1)       # 52.6
pct_motif2_prom_enh     <- round(100 * n_motif2_prom_enh / n_prom_enh, 1)       # 36.4
pct_motif2_prom_nonanno <- round(100 * n_motif2_prom_nonanno / n_prom_nonanno, 1) # 20.8
pct_motif2_dist_nonanno <- round(100 * n_motif2_dist_nonanno / n_dist_nonanno, 1) # 37.5
motif2_fisher_p <- fisher.test(tab_refined)$p.value                              # 6.86e-10
# Motif2 fold-enrichment comparisons (for Discussion 3.7.5).
#
# Fold-enrichments are computed separately for the distal-enhancer class
# and the promoter-enhancer class, using the counts defined just above,
# so that the two classes are not pooled into a single claim.
.f <- function(a, na, b, nb, dp = 1) round((a/na) / (b/nb), dp)
motif2_fold_enh_vs_prom <- .f(n_motif2_dist_enh, n_dist_enh,
                              n_motif2_prom_nonanno, n_prom_nonanno)    #2.5
motif2_fold_enh_vs_dist <- .f(n_motif2_dist_enh, n_dist_enh,
                              n_motif2_dist_nonanno, n_dist_nonanno)    #1.4
motif2_fold_pe_vs_pn    <- .f(n_motif2_prom_enh, n_prom_enh,
                              n_motif2_prom_nonanno, n_prom_nonanno)    #1.7
motif2_fold_pe_vs_dn    <- .f(n_motif2_prom_enh, n_prom_enh,
                              n_motif2_dist_nonanno, n_dist_nonanno, 2) #0.97
# High-confidence peak percentage (for §3.7.7)
pct_high_conf <- round(100 * (n_dist_enh + n_prom_enh) / joint_n, 1) #27.5
# ============================================================
# SECTION 12, CME-motif2 inter-motif spacing (Figure 3.15)
# Object: spacings, peaks_both
# ============================================================
n_peaks_both         <- length(peaks_both)            # 55
spacing_median       <- median(spacings)              # 72
spacing_min          <- min(spacings)                 # 2
spacing_max          <- max(spacings)                 # 275
n_close_apposition   <- sum(spacings <= 50)           # 17

# ============================================================
# SECTION 13, Per-chromosome table (Table 3.1), these are computed not hardcoded
# Object: chr_distribution
# ============================================================

# ============================================================
# RECORD computed values in results/reported_values.tsv
# ============================================================

# ---- Distal/proximal GO diagnostic values for results/reported_values.tsv ----
# Objects come from the load-chipenrich-ch3-distalsplit loader chunk.
stopifnot(exists("res_distal_bp_sig"), exists("res_prox_bp_sig"),
          exists("n_distal_ds"), exists("n_promoter_ds"))

# Top distal term (ordered by FDR ascending in the saved object)
.dtop <- res_distal_bp_sig[1, ]
dist_go_top_term <- as.character(.dtop$Description)            # e.g. "embryo development"
dist_go_top_or   <- formatC(.dtop$Odds.Ratio, format = "f", digits = 2)
dist_go_top_fdr  <- .dtop$FDR                                  # fmt_p() applied at write time

# --- Motif2 functional-test scalars (TEST1 regression, TEST3 phyloP) --------
AUX_CV <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "data/chapter3")
t1 <- readRDS(file.path(AUX_CV, "test1_regression_binding.rds"))
t3 <- readRDS(file.path(AUX_CV, "test3_phylop_conservation.rds"))
if (!requireNamespace("sandwich", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("sandwich")
if (!requireNamespace("lmtest",   quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("lmtest")

t1f <- summary(t1$full)$coefficients
t1b <- summary(t1$binary)$coefficients
m2_beta     <- round(t1f["n_motif2", "Estimate"], 2)
m2_beta_ci  <- sprintf("%.2f", t1f["n_motif2", "Estimate"] + c(-1.96, 1.96) * t1f["n_motif2", "Std. Error"])
m2_outcome_median <- sprintf("%.2f", median(t1$df$peak_score))
m2_reg_p    <- t1f["n_motif2", "Pr(>|t|)"]
m2_reg_p_hc <- lmtest::coeftest(t1$full,
                 vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(t1$full, type = "HC3"))["n_motif2", "Pr(>|t|)"]
m2_bin_beta <- round(t1b["has_motif2", "Estimate"], 2)
m2_bin_p    <- t1b["has_motif2", "Pr(>|t|)"]
adjr_red    <- round(summary(t1$reduced)$adj.r.squared, 3)
adjr_full   <- round(summary(t1$full)$adj.r.squared, 3)
ppk <- t3$full$table; ppc <- t3$core$table
m2_pp_n      <- nrow(ppk)
flank_w      <- t3$flank_w
m2_pp_motif  <- round(median(ppk$motif), 2)
m2_pp_flank  <- round(median(ppk$flank), 2)
m2_pp_diff   <- round(median(ppk$motif - ppk$flank), 2)
m2_pp_propup <- round(100 * mean((ppk$motif - ppk$flank) > 0), 1)
m2_pp_p      <- t3$full$wilcox$p.value
core_med     <- round(median(ppc$core), 2)
core_diff    <- round(median(ppc$core - ppc$flank), 2)
core_p       <- t3$core$wilcox$p.value
```

```{r ch3-motif2-dbscan, eval=FALSE}
# ============================================================
# TOMTOM scan of Motif2 PWM (data/chapter3/STRCACTGARARAAA.meme) against combined Fly Factor Survey + JASPAR2024 CORE insects database; result written to results/reported_values.tsv
# ============================================================

qry <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "data/chapter3/STRCACTGARARAAA.meme")
db  <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "reference/motif_databases/combined_drosophila.meme")
ffs <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "reference/motif_databases/FLY/fly_factor_survey.meme")
jas <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR,
        "reference/motif_databases/JASPAR/JASPAR2024_CORE_insects_non-redundant_v2.meme")
stopifnot(file.exists(qry), file.exists(ffs), file.exists(jas))

# Rebuild the combined database (same concatenation as the MEME-ChIP step).
if (!file.exists(db)) writeLines(c(readLines(ffs), readLines(jas)), db)
n_db <- sum(grepl("^MOTIF", readLines(db)))            # 942 matrices

# Run 1, canonical significance count. TOMTOM writes only matches <= thresh,
# so an empty table == no significant match.
oc_sig <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "data/chapter3/tomtom_motif2_vs_db_q05")
system2("tomtom", c("-no-ssc","-thresh","0.05","-min-overlap","5",
                    "-dist","pearson","-oc", oc_sig, qry, db))
tt_sig <- read.delim(file.path(oc_sig, "tomtom.tsv"),
                     comment.char = "#", check.names = FALSE)
tt_sig <- tt_sig[!is.na(tt_sig$Query_ID) & tt_sig$Query_ID != "", ]
n_hits <- nrow(tt_sig)                                 # expect 0

# Run 2, nearest neighbour (relaxed, E-value scored) for the appendix only.
oc_all <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "data/chapter3/tomtom_motif2_vs_db_all")
system2("tomtom", c("-no-ssc","-thresh","10","-evalue","-min-overlap","5",
                    "-dist","pearson","-oc", oc_all, qry, db))
tt_all <- read.delim(file.path(oc_all, "tomtom.tsv"),
                     comment.char = "#", check.names = FALSE)
tt_all <- tt_all[!is.na(tt_all$Query_ID) & tt_all$Query_ID != "", ]
tt_all <- tt_all[order(tt_all[["E-value"]]), ]

stopifnot(n_hits == 0L)     # CANONICAL FACT: Motif2 matches no catalogued TF

# ---- session objects consumed by the ch3-export chunk ----
motif2_db_nmatrices <- n_db
motif2_db_nhits     <- n_hits
motif2_db_thresh    <- "0.05"
motif2_db_nearestE  <- sprintf("%.1f", tt_all[["E-value"]][1])   # ~2.9

cat(sprintf("Motif2 vs %d TF matrices: %d matches at q<%s; nearest %s E=%.2f\n",
            n_db, n_hits, motif2_db_thresh,
            tt_all$Target_ID[1], tt_all[["E-value"]][1]))
```

```{r ch3-export-computed-values, eval=FALSE}
# ============================================================

# ============================================================

stopifnot(exists("save_values"),
          length(joint_peaks_filt) == 614L) # canonical-fact check

# The single-coefficient t-test and the nested F-test of the Motif2 dosage
# regression are the same test on 1 df; assert the identity and a plausible
# range for the p-value before recording it.
local({
  .p  <- summary(t1$full)$coefficients["n_motif2", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  .av <- anova(t1$reduced, t1$full)
  stopifnot(abs(.p - .av$`Pr(>F)`[2]) < 1e-12,   # same test, 1 df
            .p > 1e-6, .p < 0.05)                # plausible for n = 614
})

# ---- fmt_p: safe re-use if already defined in session ----
if (!exists("fmt_p")) {
  fmt_p <- function(p, digits = 2) {
    if (is.na(p)) return("NA")
    if (p == 0)   return("< 1e-300")
    s <- formatC(p, format = "e", digits = digits)
    parts <- strsplit(s, "e")[[1]]
    paste0(parts[1], "e", as.integer(parts[2]))
  }
}

  adjRReduced           = adjr_red,
  adjRFull              = adjr_full,

  # ---- TEST3: phyloP conservation ----
  nMotifTwoPhyloP       = m2_pp_n,
  flankWidth            = flank_w,
  motifTwoPhyloPMedian  = m2_pp_motif,
  flankPhyloPMedian     = m2_pp_flank,
  motifTwoPhyloPDiff    = m2_pp_diff,
  motifTwoPhyloPPropUp  = m2_pp_propup,
  motifTwoPhyloPP       = fmt_p(m2_pp_p),
  coreCactgPhyloP       = core_med,
  coreCactgPhyloPDiff   = core_diff,
  coreCactgPhyloPP      = fmt_p(core_p),

  # ---- Motif2 database-novelty scan (TOMTOM vs known Drosophila TFs) ----
  nMotifTwoDbMatrices   = motif2_db_nmatrices,   # 942
  nMotifTwoDbHits       = motif2_db_nhits,       # 0
  motifTwoDbThresh      = motif2_db_thresh,      # 0.05
  motifTwoDbNearestE    = motif2_db_nearestE,    # 2.9

  # ---- Distal/proximal GO diagnostic ----
  nProxPeaksGO          = n_promoter_ds,
  nDistPeaksGO          = n_distal_ds,
  nProxGoSigTerms       = nrow(res_prox_bp_sig),
  nDistGoSigTerms       = nrow(res_distal_bp_sig),
  distGoTopTerm         = dist_go_top_term,
  distGoTopOR           = dist_go_top_or,
  distGoTopFDR          = fmt_p(dist_go_top_fdr)

)

save_values("ch3", ch3_vals)
```

# Motif2 attribution: heterodimers vs. enhancers in general

The analyses above compare Trh/Tgo peaks against an enhancer catalogue.
That design cannot separate two accounts of the Motif2 enrichment: that
Motif2 is associated with the heterodimers, or that it is a compositional
feature of distal embryonic enhancers which the heterodimers happen to
bind. The partition test below separates them, by taking ONE enhancer
catalogue and splitting it only by whether a heterodimer peak overlaps the
enhancer. Sequence class, interval length and scan parameters are then
constant by construction.

Two conventions are load-bearing and are enforced in the script:

1. **Equal 201 bp windows for every scanned set.** The joint peaks average
   ~420 bp and the annotated enhancers ~860 bp; a longer sequence carries a
   higher per-sequence hit probability irrespective of biology, which
   understates the enrichment.
2. **`p < 1e-4` only, never FIMO's q.** FIMO computes q within a scan, so
   the burden scales with set size: the 35797-enhancer catalogue retains
   19% of its p-passing hits under `q < 0.05` while a 614-peak set retains
   88%. A q-threshold is therefore not comparable across sets of different
   size, and using one penalises the large comparator.

The analysis lives in its own script rather than inline, because it reads
all four heterodimer peak sets and belongs to no single chapter. It writes
the attribution tables (`data/motif2_attribution/`) and the figure
`results/figures/fig4_12_motif2_attribution.png` used in
the Chapter 4 section on Motif2 attribution (Chapter 4, because the partition
test requires the Sim/Dys/Sima peak sets and the non-bHLH-PAS controls
that Chapter 4 introduces).

```{r motif2-attribution, eval=FALSE}
# Sources: data/final_peaks IDR peak sets (all four heterodimers),
#          data/chapter3/enhancers_genomewide.fa,
#          data/ctrl_tf/fimo/* (Chapter 4 control scans)
# Outputs: data/motif2_attribution/*.csv
#          results/figures/fig4_12_motif2_attribution.png
# Run from the repository root:
#   Rscript 04_chapter_analyses/chapter4/ch4_motif2_attribution.R
```

```{r motif2-attribution-export, eval=FALSE}
# Lists which attribution values are recorded in results/reported_values.tsv.
# The pooled-attribution counts, odds ratios and p-values are in
# data/motif2_attribution/pooled_attribution_tests.csv; the enhancer/factor
# shares (attrEnh*, attrFac*) are recorded by
# 04_chapter_analyses/chapter4/ch4_motif2_nonenh_baseline.R.
A <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "data/motif2_attribution")
stopifnot(file.exists(file.path(A, "pooled_attribution_tests.csv")))
rv <- read.delim(VALUES_FILE, colClasses = "character", quote = "")
need <- c("attrPooledOR", "attrPooledCIlo", "attrPooledCIhi", "attrPooledP",
          "attrPooledBoundN", "attrPooledBoundPct", "attrUnboundN",
          "attrUnboundPct", "attrEnhPctShare", "attrFacPctShare",
          "attrEnhOR", "attrFacOR", "attrWindowBp",
          "attrTrhOR", "attrSimOR", "attrDysOR", "attrSimaOR",
          "mspecPeaksPctMatched", "mspecEnhPctMatched", "mspecORMatched")
missing <- setdiff(need, rv$name)
if (length(missing))
  message("attribution values not recorded in reported_values.tsv: ",
          paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
cat(sprintf("attribution values present: %d/%d\n", length(need) - length(missing),
            length(need)))
```
